name: codefokus Opening Hours with German Public Holidays
author: codefokus

sections.description:
Most opening hours plugins show “Open” on Easter Monday or All Saints’ Day, unless you enter every holiday by hand – every year. This plugin calculates the public holidays of all 16 German federal states itself and shows the correct status automatically:

  • “Open now · until 6:00 pm” / “Closing soon” / “Closed now · opens tomorrow at 8:00 am”
  • “Closed today (All Saints’ Day) · opens tomorrow at 9:00 am”

Deutsch

Öffnungszeiten mit Live-Status („Jetzt geöffnet · bis 18 Uhr“), die die gesetzlichen Feiertage deines Bundeslands automatisch kennen – lokal berechnet, ohne externe API. Deutsche Übersetzungen werden über translate.wordpress.org bereitgestellt.

Languages

The plugin is fully translatable. German translations are provided via translate.wordpress.org – contributions in any language are welcome.

Features

  • Public holidays for all 16 federal states, including movable holidays (Easter, Ascension, Whit Monday, Corpus Christi) and special cases such as Day of Repentance and Prayer (Saxony), International Women’s Day (Berlin, Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania), World Children’s Day (Thuringia) and Reformation Day.
  • 10 designs: Classic, Card, Banner, Minimal, Compact (for sidebars and footers), Dark, Elegant (for restaurants and cafés), Outline, Door sign and Tiles – with live preview on the settings page.
  • Own title, custom colors for accent, “open” and “closed”, and the block editor’s color, spacing and font size options.
  • Group days with the same hours (“Mon – Fri 9:00 – 17:00”).
  • Up to two time slots per day (e.g. lunch break).
  • Optional: closed on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve.
  • Closures and company holidays as date ranges.
  • List of upcoming closures – holidays are only listed if you would otherwise be open that day.
  • Live status that keeps working with page caching: the status is updated in the browser every minute.
  • Block for the block editor and a shortcode for classic editor, widgets and page builders.
  • Optional schema.org OpeningHoursSpecification (JSON-LD) including closed days for search engines.
  • Preview of all calculated holidays on the settings page, so you can check them.
  • No external requests, no tracking, no cookies – GDPR friendly.

Shortcode

[ohgh_opening_hours]

Attributes:

  • status="yes|no" – live status (default: yes)
  • table="yes|no" – weekly hours (default: yes)
  • closures="3" – number of upcoming closures, 0 hides the list (default: 3)
  • design="classic|card|banner|minimal|compact|dark|elegant|outline|sign|tiles" – design (default: as set on the settings page)
  • title="Opening hours" – optional title
  • group="yes|no" – group days with the same hours (default: no; always on for “compact”)
  • accent_color, open_color, closed_color – custom colors as hex values, e.g. open_color="#2e7d32"

Examples:

  • Card with title: [ohgh_opening_hours design="card" title="Öffnungszeiten"]
  • Status only, e.g. for the header: [ohgh_opening_hours design="minimal" table="no" closures="0"]
  • Footer: [ohgh_opening_hours design="compact"]

For developers

  • Filter ohgh_holidays( array $holidays, int $year, string $state ) – add or remove holidays (e.g. local holidays such as the Augsburg Peace Festival).
  • Filter ohgh_schema_data( array $data ) – modify the JSON-LD.

Developed by codefokus.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to Settings → Opening Hours, choose your federal state and enter your hours.
  3. Make sure your timezone under Settings → General is set to “Berlin”.
  4. Add the block “Opening Hours (German Holidays)” or the shortcode [ohgh_opening_hours] to a page.
sections.faq:
Which holidays are included?

All public holidays that apply to an entire federal state. Holidays that only apply in some municipalities (Corpus Christi in parts of Saxony and Thuringia, Assumption Day in parts of Bavaria, Augsburg Peace Festival) are not included automatically – add them as a closure or via the ohgh_holidays filter.

Does the status work with caching plugins?

Yes. The page contains the schedule for the next 30 days and the status is recalculated in the visitor’s browser every minute, so a cached page still shows the correct status.

Does the plugin connect to external services?

No. All holidays are calculated locally.

Can I use it for Austria or Switzerland?

Not yet – planned for a future version.

Do you support opening hours past midnight (e.g. 6 pm – 2 am)?

Not in version 1.0. As a workaround, enter 18:00–23:59 and 00:00–02:00 on the following day.

I already use an SEO plugin with schema data.

The schema output is off by default. Only enable it if no other plugin outputs your opening hours.
